tweets:
💰 A Miami dental implant practice was spending $35K/month on ads.

Their AI visibility: 18/100 (critical).

90 days later:

Here's what happened 👇

1/ The starting point:

• Monthly ad spend: $35,000
• Monthly leads: 89
• Cost per lead: $393
• AI visibility: 18/100

They were doing everything 'right.'
SEO, PPC, social.

But AI? Invisible.

2/ What we found:

❌ No MedicalOrganization schema
❌ Generic service pages
❌ No entity presence
❌ Reviews aggregated only

They were invisible to:
• ChatGPT
• Perplexity
• Google's AI Overviews

47% of their potential patients.

3/ The implementation:

Month 1: Schema audit + fix, rewrite service pages
Month 2: Entity building, FAQ schema, AI blog
Month 3: Reviews, monitoring setup

Total: $50K one-time

4/ The results:

• AI visibility: 18 → 74/100
• Monthly AI referrals: 0 → 89
• Ad spend reduction: 47%
• Cost per lead: $393 → $187

Annual savings: $165K+

ROI: 330% in year one.

5/ The key insight:

They didn't need MORE ad spend.

They needed to show up where patients were LOOKING.

47% of their market was using AI.

They were spending $35K on the other 53%.

6/ Ready to see your potential?
